competitors.title: Context Platform vs. Data Catalog: What's the Difference?

competitors.title: AI agents keep giving confident wrong answers. The context layer is enterprise AI's next production problem.
key_points: Enterprise AI agents have a new production failure mode — not the model, but fragmented business logic across SQL, BI dashboards, and agent instructions
Same underlying data produces different answers depending on which agent, tool or system asks the question

competitors.title: Why GraphRAG and MCP Are the New Standard for Agentic Data Architecture
key_points: Standard vector RAG has hit a ceiling for complex multi-hop reasoning required by 2026 agents
GraphRAG gives agents a 'map' rather than just a 'list' — enabling relationship-aware retrieval and multi-hop reasoning
Advanced context layers now automatically prune irrelevant metadata before it reaches the model — agents only need the 3 relevant columns for their current intent
MCP is the 'USB-C for AI' solving the N x M integration problem — build one MCP server, any agent can use it
Transition from flat RAG to GraphRAG is the defining architectural shift of 2026 for agentic data systems
